items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() — joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts. The registry's own copy: the default shadcn "utils" pulled a stray npm package "cn" with shadcn 4.11 (found 2026-09-25).

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Headings, body text, lead, small print and metric numbers of the design system.

items.name: tone
items.title: Tones
items.description: The five semantic tones of blocks (data, reach, access, code, muted) and the badge class.

items.name: inline
items.title: Inline markup
items.description: **bold** and [links](url) inside a line of text; external links open in a new tab.

items.name: page-body
items.title: Page body
items.description: The page factory: a page is a list of { kind, ...fields }; the set names only the blocks this project has.

items.name: block-section-head
items.title: Section head
items.description: Badge, heading and lead of a section.

items.name: block-cta-button
items.title: CTA button
items.description: The main action: a primary-colour pill with an arrow, the same look as the first screen of the site. Theme tokens only.

items.name: block-hero-centered
items.title: Hero, centered
items.description: Centered first screen: brand-colour glow, animated badge, title of at most two lines, description, optional CTA and optional second (outline) CTA and a strip of three steps. Theme tokens and typography primitives only; needs .hero-ignite, .hero-appear and .pill-ai from the design system.

items.name: block-metrics
items.title: Metrics
items.description: A row of three or four measures: a number and what it refers to.

items.name: block-badges
items.title: Badges
items.description: A row of short labels, coloured by semantic group.

items.name: block-cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A section of cards: head and a grid of 2 or 3 columns.

items.name: block-card
items.title: Card
items.description: One card: a frame with a tone fill; any blocks inside.

items.name: block-flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: How it works: three steps, one leading to the next.

items.name: block-h3
items.title: Heading 3
items.description: A third-level heading.

items.name: block-p
items.title: Paragraph
items.description: A paragraph of body text with inline markup.

items.name: app-dialog
items.title: App dialog
items.description: The project's one modal window: fixed heading and footer, scrolling body, sizes sm/md/lg, an undismissable mode for refusing access.

items.name: block-dialog-sample
items.title: Dialog sample
items.description: One setting of the app dialog opened by a button: plain, with a footer, long (the body scrolls), cannot be dismissed.

items.name: block-section-separator
items.title: Section separator
items.description: A horizontal line between two parts of a page.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: The path to this page with BreadcrumbList markup — one source for the visitor and the search engine.

items.name: block-faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions and answers with FAQPage markup; the answer allows inline links.

items.name: block-showcase-frame
items.title: Showcase frame
items.description: A section menu on the left and a preview frame on the right — no client JavaScript: menu links open in the frame by target.

items.name: block-warning-card
items.title: Warning card
items.description: A warning: the cost or risk of a decision the person is about to take. Title and text in the theme destructive tone; no colours of its own.
